verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Great is the Lord, so worthy of praise
Great is the Lord
One generation will commend Your kingdom
To one another, they will speak of You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
And I will meditate on Your wonder
And they will speak of Your glorious splendor
Of Your majesty, every day I’ll praise Thee
Forever and ever

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Every day I will praise
Every day I will praise
For You open Your hand
And satisfy desires of all things
My God the King

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The Lord is gracious and slow to anger
He is rich in love, He is good to all

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
All who call on Him in truth He is near to
And He hears their cry and saves them

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Lord, You are gracious
You are slow to anger
Abounding in love
You are good to all
